Comment: Overworld enemy stats and the rule that decides which placed NPCs spawn hostile. Read by EnemyDefinitionCollection (Sanctuary.Game/Resources). An NPC definition (Npcs.json) becomes a hostile CombatNpc when its NameId matches a Species entry, or (fallback) when its ModelId is in HostileModelIds and it has no quest role; FriendlyNpcIds always wins. Stats come from the per-level curves times the tier multipliers unless a species overrides Health/Damage/Xp directly. HealthByLevel is the player COMBAT-job health curve decoded from the March 2014 captures (round(500 x 1.15^(level-1)), research/level-stats.md) - observed mobs sit on it exactly (Frostfang wolves 760 = level 4, Feathered Drakes 16,143 = 3 x level 18, Frostfang Alpha 3,800 = 5 x level 4). DamageByLevel is a fit through the two observed raw hits (~25 at level 4, 206 at level ~18): round(20 x 1.15^(level-1)). XpByLevel is OUR assumption (round(15 x 1.10^(level-1))) tuned against RankLevels.json (300 stars from level 1 to 2, i.e. ~20 wolf kills or the newbie quests plus a few fights); no kill-XP data survived. Tier Health multipliers Elite x3 and Boss x5 are capture-derived; Weak/Tough and every Damage/Xp multiplier are Sulphural/main's (12049172). Energy 800 is the observed mob mana.
TierKeywordsComment: Sulphural/main's EnemyTiers.FromName keyword sets (12049172), checked most specific first, used only when a species does not name its tier. The Elite damage x1.0 and Boss x1.8 above replace Sulphural's x1.6/x2.2: the captured drakes (3x HP) hit for the plain level value and the Alpha for ~1.8x a pack wolf.

Defaults.Comment: Applied to every enemy unless the species overrides it. Level 3 is Sulphural's overworld baseline (WorldEnemyLevel); aggro 15 / leash 40 / melee reach 5 / respawn 8 s / chase speed 6 are its live-tested values (c34648df, a126be4b). The 2.4 s swing is the captured drake cadence.

HostileModelIdsComment: Fallback rule for unnamed creature spawns, seeded from Sulphural/main's curated overworld bestiary (7086796b, DungeonCatalog.WorldEnemyModelIds). Deliberately trimmed to creature models whose placed instances are all monsters: the humanoid models on Sulphural's list (trolls 77/166/167/739/314/408, robgoblin villagers 4/190/191, Blackspore thieves 669/685/730/1054, the Halloween wraiths 4563-4565, Darkthorne 353) flip named townsfolk and quest characters in Snowhill, Sunstone and Blackspore, and the retail town rosters keep those friendly. Add ids here (or a Species entry) to make more of the world fight back.
FriendlyNpcIdsComment: Npcs.json ids that must never spawn hostile even if a rule above matches them (seasonal set pieces, decorative spawns, named characters sharing a monster model). Rizzle, Whirly Willis and Scrap Collector Flashbang are named Sunstone Valley robgoblins on the Robgoblin Mechanic model (1681), kept friendly until their retail roles are confirmed.

Species.Comment: Hooligan Wolf - Mac's hooligans' wolves on the road west of Cobblestone Village (Npcs.json 3156-3158 at -2100,-46,460 and 4164-4166 at -1925,-49,296). Newbie-area pack: level 1, 500 HP, 20 damage, 15 stars.
Hooligan - Mac's crew standing around the village outskirts and the outlying camps (4154, 4155, 4159-4161, 4667-4675 area). Level 2, 575 HP, 23 damage, 17 stars.

Hooligan Archer (4157, 4158 and the camp archers). Level 2 like the brawlers; longer reach so they shoot from a few paces back (the client plays the bow contact event; there is no server projectile for mobs yet).

Alpha Wolf - the three placed alphas near Lakeshore (Npcs.json 3096, 3101, 3105 around -600, 1, 1160). Boss tier on level 4: 3,800 HP, 54 damage, which is the captured Frostfang Alpha exactly (5 x a level-4 pack wolf). Same model as the Hooligan Wolves, so the HostileModelIds rule would have caught them anyway; listed so the numbers are explicit.
